abilities.name: Ember Bolt
abilities.description: A lobbed ember that bursts on impact: 22 at the heart of the blast, 14 to everything around it. Aim it at a body and the falloff is a reward for hitting; aim it between two and it still catches both.

abilities.name: Flare Burst
abilities.description: A clinging flare: 10 on impact, then 6 burn at the end of each of the next 2 turns, and Revealed for 2 turns. The roster's stealth counter, now with a lit fuse.

abilities.name: Stoke the Flame
abilities.description: FREE ACTION — costs no ability, so Cinder buffs and still acts. Allies in the aimed area gain Might and Energized for a turn. Self-cast when fighting alone.

abilities.name: Backdraft
abilities.description: Vanish in a gout of smoke, reappearing up to 4 squares away. Dodges Blast attacks aimed at your old square.

ultimate.name: Solar Flare
ultimate.description: A miniature sun: 30 on detonation, 8 burn at the end of each of the next 2 turns, and Weaken for a turn. Damage now, more damage arriving, and a blunted counter-swing. (100 energy)
